svg.title: Глава 10 — подробная шпаргалка
svg.desc: Detailed network applications and services summary: SSH, diagnostics, security, RPC and sockets.
svg.text: application protocols · SSH · service activation · diagnostics · RPC · security · network/Unix sockets

text.tspan: Client initiates connection; server listens.
Application protocol runs over transport.
telnet example exposes raw plaintext HTTP.
curl trace shows structured HTTP exchange.
Transport success alone does not prove app health.
sshd uses /etc/ssh/sshd_config + host keys.
Private host key must remain secret.
systemctl enable/start controls service lifecycle.
fail2ban reacts to repeated failed logins.
Socket activation exists but is not source-preferred.
ssh verifies server host identity.
known_hosts mismatch is a security signal.
Confirm legitimate key change first.
scp/sftp replace insecure legacy transfer tools.
Trust state is not disposable metadata.
netstat: connections/listeners and transport state.
lsof: map ports/connections to PID, user and process.
netcat: manually connect or create temporary listener.
tcpdump: packet-level evidence with protocol filters.
nmap: discover exposed ports on authorized targets.
Use packet capture only after narrower evidence is insufficient.
inetd historically listened for multiple services.
xinetd added configuration/access-control features.
systemd largely replaced these activation patterns.
tcpd + hosts.allow/deny are legacy TCP wrappers.
rpcbind maps RPC program numbers to TCP/UDP ports.
rpcinfo -p localhost shows local RPC registrations.
Run the fewest possible services.
Firewall hidden/internal services.
Update internet-facing services.
Restrict user accounts and binaries.
Avoid plaintext ftpd/telnetd/rlogind/rexecd.
Socket is user-space ↔ kernel network interface.
TCP uses stream sockets; UDP uses datagram sockets.
Listening socket waits for connections.
accept() creates per-connection socket.
Handler may be split with fork().
Local IPC without IP network configuration.
Can use filesystem socket for access control.
Can also be unnamed.
Usually avoids network-stack overhead.
lsof -U maps active Unix-domain sockets.

svg.text: Operational model: identify listener/process → confirm endpoint → inspect protocol/trust → capture packets only when necessary.
